key_insight: Reinforcement learning guides adaptive grid refinement for Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman equations, concentrating nodes where discretization error is large to support optimal feedback control.
engineering_relevance: Error-focused grid refinement could reduce computational demands when computing feedback controllers without uniformly increasing state-space resolution.
method: Solve the HJB PDE on a computational grid.
Use reinforcement learning to guide adaptive grid refinement.
Target fewer total nodes with higher density in high-error regions.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes the approach and intended benefits but reports no benchmarks, quantitative accuracy gains, or node-count reductions.
watch_item: Scalability with state-space dimension and the computational overhead of RL-guided refinement remain unestablished in the abstract.
paper_title: Adaptive Grid Refinement for Optimal Feedback Control
